change: Removed Biceps Brachii from secondary — no elbow flexion occurs in this scapular retraction exercise. Added Upper Traps to a new mid back secondary entry — the upper trapezius assists scapular elevation and stability during the retraction movement. Erector Spinae secondary retained for spinal support.

Corrected primary chest: feet-in-handles configuration places feet higher than hands (true decline angle), making Sternal Head dominant. Moved Clavicular Head to secondary. Per decline push-up biomechanics (multiple sources): lower chest is primary mover, upper chest is secondary. All other secondaries (Triceps, Anterior Deltoids, abs) retained unchanged.

Replaced Posterior Deltoid secondary with Lats (Latissimus Dorsi) — confirmed by multiple sources that the lats are the primary stabilizer during any hanging exercise, actively depressing the scapulae and stabilizing the shoulder girdle. Posterior Deltoid is a minor stabilizer at best and was replaced by the clearly more significant lat contribution. Grip/forearms and obliques and Abductor (hip flexors) retained.

Added Gastrocnemius Lateral to the Calves secondary entry — was missing from the original (only Gastrocnemius Medial and Soleus were listed). Both heads of gastrocnemius activate during single-leg squat stabilization. No other changes.

No changes — data is correct. Sternal Head primary, Clavicular Head secondary (correct for decline angle). Anterior Deltoids and Triceps Brachii as secondary are confirmed by biomechanics of the Svend press (horizontal adduction + press movement).
